translations.web: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.
translations.bsb: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they went to the tomb.
translations.kjv: And very early in the morning the first day of the week, they came unto the sepulchre at the rising of the sun.
translations.asv: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
